title: 第23章 蛛王托孤第24章 突破双重打击
slug: 我妈等着治病你召唤我当勇者
content_zh:
林默和殷血都听得真真切切。
这绝非魔物的嘶吼。
而是字正腔圆的人类语言。
林默握着黑剑的手瞬间绷紧。
殷血也嗖地一下完全缩到了林默身后。
只探出半个小脑袋。
巢穴里，竟然藏着一只会说人话的兽王！？
似乎是察觉到了两人几乎凝成实质的警惕和紧张。
门后的声音轻轻笑了一声，那笑声依旧柔和。
带着一种安抚的意味：“两位没必要这么紧张。我邀请你们下来，并非为了战斗，只是想……请求你们一件事。”
话音落下。
只见那扇被厚重蛛丝缠绕封锁的洞穴。
其上交织的银亮蛛丝如同拥有生命般，主动向两侧滑开。
露出了一个足够两人并肩通过的入口。
门后是一片深邃的黑暗，唯有那柔和的女声从中传来：“两位，可以进来聊聊么？”
林默与殷血对视一眼。
都从对方眼中看到了浓重的惊愕与疑虑。
事态的发展已经完全超出了他们的预料。
但对方展现出的沟通意愿，反而勾起了他们强烈的好奇心。
略一沉吟，林默对殷血微微颔首。

前面就是自己突破11级的技能精髓。
只要吞噬了它，自己很快就能看到老妈了。
这么想着，林默果断迈步。
两人一前一后，踏入了那蛛丝之门。
进入洞穴，这里的景象，让他们的呼吸都为之一滞。
这是一个极为广阔的地下洞窟。
穹顶高悬，四周的岩壁上布满了密密麻麻的、如同蜂巢般的蛛网通道。
而在洞窟中央。
数只体型如同小型卡车般的精英暗墨蜘蛛匍匐在地。
它们甲壳幽暗，复眼闪烁着凶光，散发出的气息令人心悸。
显然比之前遇到的任何一只精英蜘蛛都要更强。
而在这些精英蜘蛛的簇拥之下。
是一只足有十几米的巨蛛！
它的下半身是完完全全的蜘蛛形态。
八条如同巨柱般的步足支撑着山峦般的躯体。
content_en:
Lin Mo and Yin Xue both heard it very clearly.
This is definitely not the roar of a monster.
It's human language that's well-spoken and well-spoken.
Lin Mo's hand holding the black sword tensed instantly.
Yin Xue also shrank completely behind Lin Mo.
Only half of the little head poked out.
There is actually a beast king hiding in the lair who can speak human language! ?
It seemed that they were aware of the vigilance and nervousness that the two of them were almost condensing into.
The voice behind the door laughed softly, the laughter still soft.
With a sense of comfort: "You two don't need to be so nervous. I invite you down not to fight, but just to...ask you for something."
The words fell.
All I saw was the cave that was wrapped and sealed by thick spider silk.
The silvery bright spider silk intertwined on it actively slides open to both sides as if it is alive.
An entrance large enough for two people to pass through side by side was revealed.
There was deep darkness behind the door, and only the soft female voice came from it: "You two, can you come in and have a chat?"
Lin Mo and Yin Xue looked at each other.
They all saw strong shock and doubt in each other's eyes.
The development of the situation has completely exceeded their expectations.
But the willingness to communicate shown by the other party aroused their strong curiosity.
After thinking for a moment, Lin Mo nodded slightly to Yin Xue.
The front is the essence of his skills to break through to level 11.
As long as he swallows it, he will be able to see his mother soon.
With this thought in mind, Lin Mo took a decisive step.
The two of them stepped into the spider silk door one after the other.
Entering the cave, the sight here made their breath stagnate.
This is an extremely vast underground cave.
The dome hangs high, and the surrounding rock walls are covered with dense, honeycomb-like spider web channels.
And in the center of the cave.
Several elite dark ink spiders that were as big as small trucks were crawling on the ground.
Their carapace is dark, their compound eyes flash with a fierce light, and their aura is heart-stopping.
It is obviously stronger than any elite spider encountered before.
And surrounded by these elite spiders.
It's a giant spider that's more than ten meters tall!
Its lower body is completely in the shape of a spider.
Eight giant pillar-like legs support the mountain-like body.
